messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: proposing a small base-image cutover this Friday to move app runtimes to distroless, drop CAP_SYS_PTRACE and CAP_SYS_ADMIN, and tighten seccomp. Goal: reduce attack surface and remove debugging helpers. Canary -> small grad roll. Need RBAC + KMS signing path review.

maria: Sounds good. Any userland UID/GID changes or passwd/nss issues we should test?

nina: No passwd changes; we’ll keep same app uid. Biggest risk is missing /etc/ssl/certs path with distroless -> certs mount we already have. Testing matrix attached in PR.

samir: Two asks: 1) ensure cosign verification is required in admission controller for the cluster, 2) KMS key rotation window: do we rotate keys before or after the cutover?

lee: Admission already has image policy webhook enabled in staging but not prod. We should flip staging first and run a 1-hour canary.

nina: Plan: staging webhook ON + require cosign verified images. We'll sign with existing key `rebuild-minor-2026`. No rotation this week to avoid churn.

sec-oncall: RBAC note: don't bind broad `cloudkms.admin`. Use a narrow binding: `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on the specific cryptoKey resource. Add a condition restricting callers to `serviceAccount:ci-rebuild@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` or the `image-signers` group.

maria: Can you paste the conditional binding form?

sec-oncall: Sure:
```
- role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
  members:
    - serviceAccount:ci-rebuild@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    - group:image-signers@redwood.com
  condition:
    title: "distroless-cutover-only"
    expression: "resource.name.endsWith('/cryptoKeys/rebuild-minor-2026') && request.time < timestamp('2026-04-10T00:00:00Z')"
```
This also limits the window.

samir: Good. Also ensure KMS audit logs stream to sec-logs and we have an alert: any sign event outside business hours or by unknown caller -> Pager.

nina: CI cosign command (in pipeline):
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-minor-2026 $IMAGE
```
and verification in admission uses the same key.

lee: One operational snag we found in staging earlier: distroless images didn't include `/usr/local/bin/start.sh` because our Dockerfile COPY path changed. Add a smoke test to CI that runs `ctr run --rm` and checks `/bin/ps` presence.

maria: We'll add that. Also add an init `chown` step for any PVC-backed volumes to avoid permission errors after capability drops.

deploy-bot: deploy: staging canary scheduled for 2026-04-02T18:00Z; awaiting approvals (required=2)

nina: Monitoring checklist for canary: container CrashLoopBackOff, image verify failures, seccomp deny logs (kube-audit), KMS sign audit entry, SBOM hash match. If any fail -> abort and revert to previous tag.

samir: Add runbook snippet to PR: quick revert command + how to disable admission temporarily (kubectl patch ValidatingWebhookConfiguration).

sec-oncall: Also ensure runtime seccomp denials are exported to the SIEM and correlate with image verify events. If we see denials and no cosign verify failures, page runtime-sre.

lee: I'll add the smoke tests and the init chown to the canary manifest.

nina: small gotcha: some helper cronjobs mount hostPath and relied on CAP_SYS_ADMIN. We'll identify and either exclude those cronjobs from this rollout or rework them to use a helper container. See PR checklist.

maria: Approving on principle. Waiting for IAM PR and alert rule PR.

samir: I'll open the alerting PR and add the KMS export config.

deploy-bot: approval status: required=2, current=1 (maria)

nina: Thanks team. Tagging @sec-oncall for a final pass after PRs are linked. If staging looks good, we'll schedule a short prod window next Tue. :thumbsup:
